race.description: Reeds Cranes & Haulage Backpacks 4 VIC Kids Hcp
race.comment: COL KLINK (4) finds a nice race. He was excellent winning first up at Bendigo then has just been found wanting to 1400m his past couple in stronger races, the pattern against last time. Comes back to a BM66 and 1200m with Mark Zahra booked, if he can hold a spot early he'll go close. STAKES (6) resumes. He's won 2/3 to date and looks a nice type for the Hayes yard. The market will tell plenty with him. NATION STATE (1) just found one better first up here in a similar race and that form is solid. Drawn wide but rolls forward and can go one better. INTEREST POINT (2) was good in a tougher race last time and looks well placed.
